message: １０年後の布石
There are roughly two months left until the Holy Night Festival. Now then, what kind of Christmas should we make it?
KiraFes was a huge success thanks to all the students and the cooperation of the people in Ryuusei Town, starting with the Shiokumi Shopping District.

We'll likely have to ask the townsfolk for quite a bit of help when holding the Holy Night Festival, too. Nanaka and I have decent connections in the Shiokumi Shopping District, but when it comes to all of Ryuusei Town, I'm not so sure...
The person with the widest reach among the people of Ryuusei Town is--

name: Synn
message: 「―The one with the most pull has to be Shio―chan.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, anyone livin' in this town who don't know Asukai Shrine is a total amateur.」

name: Shio
message: 「Why, if it isn't Sir Synn. Thank you for your hard work at KiraFes.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--!? Why is Sakura-kun here?」

name: Shio
message: 「To pay his respects, no doubt. The shrine grounds are open to all, after all.」
Misa and Shio-chan came walking up from the rear approach, carrying plastic shopping bags from Capricore. Inside the translucent bags, pumpkins of all sizes were packed to the brim.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, welcome back. Out shopping for dinner together, you two? Looks like it's an all-pumpkin feast tonight.」

name: Shio
message: 「Not quite on the mark, yet not far off either.」

name: Misa
message: 「You're way off. Where in the world would you find a high school girl who eats five or six whole pumpkins for dinner?」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, how could you say that! Pumpkins are delicious!」

name: Misa
message: 「Why are you getting so worked up over this!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Sir Synn, today is Halloween, is it not?」

name: Shio
message: 「Every year, Elder Sister and yours truly bake pumpkin sweets and share them with the children who come to play at the shrine.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yep, this year it's pumpkin cake and scones.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, really? What a shame--if I were still little, I could've gotten some too.」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm, yours truly would dearly love for you to have a taste as well, Sir Synn, however...」

name: Misa
message: 「The little kids gobble them all up in no time flat, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「That just goes to show how good your cooking is. It's amazing that you two can make sweets like that.」

name: Shio
message: 「Kuhi...!? I-Indeed!」

name: Shio
message: 「Though yours truly devotes every day to exorcism training, I have not abandoned my maidenly heart. Whipping up a dish or two is...!」

name: Misa
message: 「Pfft, heehee, Shio's... heehee」

name: Misa
message: 「Did you know, Sakura-kun? Shio is super good at cutting ingredients. Her skills are practically on par with an Iron Chef」

name: Shio
message: 「P-Please do not praise me so. This humble one is growing bashful」

name: Misa
message: 「However, when it comes to the actual cooking, it's just--」

name: Shio
message: 「Nghhh」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmphh!?」

name: Shio
message: 「What is this?! Elder Sister's lips are terribly dry and chapped!」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmph-mmph!! Mmmph-mmph-mmph-mmph-mmph」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm, hmm, autumn has arrived and the air has grown dry, leaving your lips terribly sore, yet you have been enduring it out of sheer stubbornness?」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmmph-mmph, mmmph-mmph-mph! Mmph-mmph-mmph-mmph!」

name: Shio
message: 「Understood!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Come, come, let us head to my quarters for the time being. We must apply honey to your lips and administer first aid at once!」

name: Shio
message: 「Now then, Lord Synn, I take my leave」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yeah, good luck with the cooking」

name: Shio
message: 「Nngh...」

name: Misa
message: 「M-Mmmphhh!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh boy~~\s02 She dragged Misa away, pumpkin and all」

name: Paqy
message: 「In a way, that's some serious hysterical strength」

name: Synn
message: 「They seem busy, so let's save our chat for another time」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, Shio-chan really gets along great with the kids, doesn't she? I'm looking forward to the Holy Night Festival ten years from now」

name: Paqy
message: 「Just how far ahead are you thinking?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「There's something else you oughta be surprised about, y'know? Didn't you notice?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course I did?」

name: Synn
message: 「Being able to heal chapped lips by putting honey on them takes incredible willpower. I always end up licking it right off」

name: Paqy
message: 「THAT'S the part you're impressed by?!」
Chatting idly about how close Shio-chan and Misa are as sisters, Paqy and I make our way down Omotesando.
